routes.cleaner: Make space for what matters. Scan for clutter, compare categories, then review what to remove.
routes.registry: Find outdated registry entries and review the proposed fixes before making changes.
routes.contextMenu: A simpler right-click menu. Review shell extensions, then disable entries you don't need.
routes.startup: Give your next startup a little breathing room. Review high-impact apps first.
routes.disk: See where your space goes. Choose a drive, analyze it, and explore the folders behind the numbers.
routes.duplicates: One good copy is often enough. Compare matching files and choose which copies to keep.
routes.largeFiles: Find the files making the biggest impression on your storage. Review them by size and location.
routes.emptyFolders: Tidy the spaces left behind. Choose a folder and review empty directories before removing them.
routes.shredder: Permanently erase files you choose. Check every selected path before confirming removal.
routes.repair: Investigate Windows file and disk problems with a focused check. Each tool explains what it repairs.
routes.maintenance: Give each drive the right care. Review drive type and available maintenance before running a task.
routes.network: Review saved network data. Clear caches or remove old connections individually, when you need to.
routes.malware: Check for malware and suspicious files. Review the findings and choose how to handle each detection.
routes.cve: Turn vulnerability findings into a plan. Review higher-severity issues and update affected software.
routes.gameMode: Make room for play. Review the optimizations and activate them when you're ready.
routes.performance: Understand what your PC is doing. Compare resource trends and find the processes behind the load.
routes.uninstaller: Keep the apps you use. Review an app's details before uninstalling or removing leftover files.
routes.history: The last 100 scans and cleanups run on this PC, with date, duration, items processed and space freed, and the receipt of each cleanup.
routes.settings: Appearance, language, startup, notifications, updates, backups, cleaning preferences and exclusions. Every change is saved immediately.
routes.about: Open source, thoughtfully made. Find your version, check for updates, and meet the project.
routes.breach: Check whether an email appears in known breaches. Review what was exposed and the recommended next steps.
routes.privacy: Choose what your computer shares. Review each recommendation and keep the settings you rely on.
routes.services: Understand the services behind your system. Check purpose and safety before changing startup behavior.
routes.firewall: See which apps can accept connections. Inspect broad rules and missing programs before making changes.
routes.debloater: Make Windows more your own. Review preinstalled packages and remove only the apps you don't need.
routes.updates: Keep your everyday essentials current. Check available updates, compare versions, and choose what to install.
routes.schedules: Good care, on your schedule. Choose the tasks, timing, and frequency that suit this computer.
routes.drivers: Review driver updates and older packages in one place. Check the proposed changes before applying them.
routes.storageHistory: See what is growing. Save local folder snapshots and compare where storage has changed.
routes.recovery: Changes to the registry, services and scheduled tasks made by SuperSonicCleaner, with the backups to undo them. Deleted files cannot be recovered.
routes.diagnostics: Record a slowdown, stop and save, then analyze the measurements on this device.

home.collecting: Collecting readings. Your graph will appear shortly.

schedules.conditions: Planned times. Run conditions can defer a task.
